claim: A test that skips a routine proves it display-only only on the paths the recording takes; branches never taken and code the stage patches elsewhere stay unchecked, so read the disassembly too.

evidence.text: Skipping the copier kept game RAM equal on levels 1-4 and 6 once the recorded LD A,R values were fed; disassembly then found gameplay logic (9804) inside the copier.
Raster stage skipped over all frames (5,281 calls): the only raster-written areas were display-only, marked observed.
